name: Connie Williams
source:
A math teacher at Tina Koya who also oversees [url=https://vndb.org/c174069]John[/url]'s homeroom. A very kind woman, she tries hard to gain the favor of her students. Unfortunately she has a peculiar sense of humor, often telling lame jokes and puns which only [url=https://vndb.org/c174073]Kiyoshy[/url] seems to appreciate.
